gaps.sentence: ___ the price, the location is absolutely perfect.
gaps.explanation: 'Apart from the price' = the only negative in an otherwise positive description.

gaps.sentence: ___ the strike, trains will run a reduced service all week.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of the strike' gives the reason for the reduced service.

gaps.sentence: ___ his impressive qualifications, he wasn't even shortlisted.
___ the weather improves, the crossing will be cancelled.
gaps.explanation: Unless = if the weather doesn't improve — matching the cancellation.

gaps.sentence: After years of setbacks, the tunnel was ___ completed in 2019.
gaps.explanation: 'Eventually' = in the end, after a long delay or difficulty.

gaps.sentence: The match went ahead ___ the pouring rain.
gaps.explanation: Despite + noun phrase; 'although the rain' would need a clause (although it was raining).

gaps.sentence: I will send the report today ___ you asked for it early.
The economy has strengthened; ___, unemployment keeps rising.
gaps.explanation: Rising unemployment goes against the positive trend: however marks the contrast.
